title: Find the K-or of an Array
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, compute the K-or value.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, compute the K-or value. The K-or value is determined by setting a bit to 1 in the result if and only if at least k numbers in nums have that bit set to 1.
constraints: For each nonnegative bit position, count how many array values contain that bit.
Set the bit in the answer when its count is at least k.
Return the integer represented by all qualifying bits.
hints: Bits contribute independently to the result.
Count the one bits at each position across all values.
Set position b by OR-ing 1<<b exactly when its count reaches k.
The definition makes no cross-bit interaction, so evaluating every supported position separately constructs precisely the k-or.
